"''How effortlessly you lie.|Squidna talking with Mon Mothma|audio=Squidna-Mothma-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Squidna''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was partner of the human male [[Sordo]]. In [[4 BBY]], they attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]], the latter of who was daughter of Sordo's nephew [[Perrin Fertha]] and his [[Marriage|wife]] [[Mon Mothma]]. Fertha and Mon greeted Sordo and Squidna when they arrived at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]] and the couple later spoke to the bride and groom. On the second [[Local day|day]] of the wedding, Squidna watched Fertha giving a wedding speech at dinner and on the third day the uncle observed the wedding ceremony in one of the estate's courtyards. ==Biography== {{Quote|Mon, we'll see you. Come on, Sordo.''"
"''Yes, I'm coming.|Squidna and Sordo|{{Andor|Harvest}}}} Squidna was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was partner to the human male [[Sordo]]. In [[4 BBY]], Sordo and Squidna attended the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] [[Leida Mothma]], and fellow [[Chandrilan]] [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]]. After arriving in an [[airspeeder]] on the first day, Sordo and Squidna were greeted by [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Perrin Fertha]], parents to Leida. Later that [[Standard day|night]], Sordo and Squidna spoke with Leida and Sculdun inside one of the estate's buildings. The bride and groom schmoozed the older couple as Fertha and Stekan's father [[Davo Sculdun]] watched. On the second day of the wedding, Sordo and Squidna attended the wedding dinner on the estate. Squidna sat a few places down beside Mon while Fertha gave a speech from a dais in the center of the room, welcoming the guests in [[Chandrilan (language)|Chandrilan]] and toasting their health before offering advice to the bride and groom.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} On the third and final day of the wedding, Sordo and Squidna attended the ceremony in one of the estate's courtyards, standing together observing the ritual in which Stekan cut the left braid of Leida's [[hair]]. Later in the day, Sordo and Squidna were part of the crowd that watched Davo unveil his wedding gift to the newly-weds, a [[Chandi Merle]] statue. Afterward Sordo and Squidna were speaking with Mon until her business partner [[Tay Kolma]] approached, at which point Squidna led Sordo away. Soon after, Sordo and Squidna watched Leida and Stekan perform their first dance after which the guests mingled. A [[speaker droid]] then entered the room and began playing [[music]] for the guests to dance to. ==Personality and traits== Squidna had light skin, blue [[eye]]s and [[Color|white]] [[hair]]. When she arrived to the Mothma Estate, Squidna greeted Mon Mothma and commented on the events. Although Squidna knew that Mothma was lying when she noted that the other human was looking younger by each season, she appeared to be gratified nonetheless. ==Equipment== On the first day of the wedding, Squidna wore tan [[clothing|dress]] with matching tan over coat, large [[Piercing|earrings]], a tan necklace which included four large beads, and a tan [[ring]] on their right hand. Squidna changed into a changed to gold colored dress on the second day and finally wearing a purple dress on the third. ==Behind the scenes== Squidna was portrayed by [[Suzanne Bertish]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first episode, "[[One Year Later]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st|"[[Sagrona Teema]]" and "[[Harvest]]}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/2025-emmy-award-winners-andor|text=''Andor'' Wins Four Creative Arts Emmy® Awards}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Squidna|imagecat=Images of Squidna}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=スキンダ |ka=სკვიდნა }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
